questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Spot the mistakes: find and fix the 5 misspelled words.
questions.answer: hikeing → hiking; shiney → shiny; bakeed → baked; smileing → smiling; niceist → nicest
questions.hint: Read each word slowly.
questions.text: On Sunday we went hikeing in the hills. The sun was very shiney and the grass looked green. We stopped for lunch and ate a bakeed pie. Dad was smileing all day. Later, we said it was the niceist walk ever.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Spot the mistakes: find and fix the 5 misspelled words in this story about Grandpa.
questions.answer: hikker → hiker; hikeed → hiked; bonny → bony; nicor → nicer; latter → later
questions.hint: Read each word slowly.
questions.text: My grandpa is a keen hikker. He hikeed up a big hill last week. He took some cakes that he had baked. His dog has a bonny tail that wags all the time. Grandpa says next time the walk will be even nicor and he will come home latter.
